lines.text: The psalmist tells his soul to praise the LORD and vows to sing praises to his God all his life.
The psalm says not to trust in princes, who cannot save, because when their spirit departs, they return to the ground.
Blessed is the one whose help is the God of Abraham, the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
The LORD executes justice for the oppressed, feeds the hungry, sets the prisoners free, and opens the eyes of the deaf.
The LORD protects foreigners, sustains the fatherless and the widow, frustrates the wicked, and reigns forever as Zion's God.
